JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending),
closing AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
    SELECT cp.category,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7 THEN f.quantity END) AS prior4,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 27 AND params.week_ending THEN f.quantity END) AS incl4,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7 AND f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity END) AS staff_prior4
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.category, c.closing_units, s.prior4, s.incl4, s.staff_prior4,
       ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.prior4/4.0), 2) AS woc_prior4, ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.incl4/4.0), 2) AS woc_incl
FROM closing c LEFT JOIN sold s USING (category) ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.quantity, f.sale_date, s.store_id, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM l) AS lines_all,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM l) AS dist_line_ids,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM l) AS dist_receipt_lines,
       (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM l WHERE store_id<900 AND category<>'ZZ Test') AS units_clean,
       (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM l WHERE store_id<900) AS units_phys_incl_test,
       (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND store_id<900) AS rpt_units,
       (SELECT min(quantity) FROM l) AS min_qty,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT sale_date) FROM l WHERE store_id<900) AS days
